    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("eng", R / "helpers/benchmarking/run_engine.py")
    E = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(E)
    E.configure(R / "dev/mixing2006/config/runs/r133.json")
    return E


def one(f):
    E = _engine()
    rep = json.loads((RUN / "report.json").read_text())
    names = E.free_shape_names(f)
    x0 = E.x_from_physical({n: rep["fitted"][n] for n in names}, E.FC_DEFAULT, f)
    t0 = time.time()
    res = E._fit_worker(str(RUN), 0, 0, list(x0), None, 1500, E.FC_DEFAULT, E.DISCREPANCY, 6, E.NORM_FIXED, f)
    return {"f_isovector": f, "chi2": res["fun"], "nfev": res["nfev"], "converged": res["converged"],
            "x": [float(v) for v in res["x"]], "seconds": time.time() - t0}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    with cf.ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as ex:
        out = list(ex.map(one, VALUES))
    rep = json.loads((RUN / "report.json").read_text())
    vac = rep["isovector_test"]["chi2_vacuum"] if "chi2_vacuum" in rep["isovector_test"] else None
    s2 = None
    for line in (RUN / "REPORT.md").read_text().splitlines():
        if "S^2 = chi2/ndf" in line:
            s2 = float(line.split("S^2 = chi2/ndf = ")[1].split()[0])
    rec = {"profile": out, "chi2_vacuum_only": vac, "s2": s2}
    Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(rec, indent=1))
    print(json.dumps(rec, indent=1))
